name: Rebun (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Rebun town emblem in maroon: a ring crossed by a stylised letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Rebun, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1967.

features.role: Rebun town emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised letter V
